title: Page header actions show no in-flight state: a click on a slow action (e.g. Convert Lead) leaves the button live and silent until the dialog or result arrives
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Found by the hotcrm lane on @objectstack 18.5.0 during hotcrm#2432 (row 7, "a silent lead-conversion open"; readings in hotcrm#2432 comment 6946609306). Read in code on objectstack `main` fc5913e117.

## What happens

On a lead's record page, a click on the header action **Convert Lead** gives no feedback while the action loads its dialog: the button stays enabled and unchanged, nothing says work is under way, and a user clicks again.

## Why, in code

`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` ~2636–2660: the header action `Button` takes `disabled={isActionDisabled(action)}` (inline-edit lock or the declared `disabled`) and its `onClick` fires `void action.onClick()` or `dispatchHeaderAction(action)` without awaiting it. No pending state is kept, so the button is neither disabled nor marked busy (`aria-busy`, a spinner) between the click and the result.

## Asked

While a header action's click is in flight, the button shows it (disabled plus a spinner or `aria-busy`) and ignores further clicks; it returns to normal when the dialog opens or the action settles, success or failure. The same for the mobile action bar face, which shares this renderer.

## Done when

Clicking Convert Lead on a slow environment shows a busy button at once, a second click does nothing, and the button is normal again once the dialog is open.
